label: The selected rigid n actually exists and exists at every root-accessible world
paraphrase: The selected rigid n actually exists and exists at every root-accessible world. At every such world its degree bounds the degrees of all individuals existing at any root-accessible world. Ties and other necessary individuals are allowed; no value maximum, actual causal exercise, divine identity or uniqueness is asserted.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Derive GreatestBeingDegreeAttained InAct esse value for the same n with value := intensity w0. This needs three inputs. First, reflexivity at w0 (2b20b5af-d653-56ba-8001-35903fb3d1ea), so that the bound covers individuals existing at w0. Second, a two-way contract that InAct x esse holds exactly for x existing at w0: the one-way ExistingInActAt (0436de86-6579-53f2-9ff5-2111ba44ebae) gives only existence to act. Third, an explicit sense bridge identifying the Koons existence intensity at the actual world with the Fourth Way represented degree of being.
connection_plan.blocker: The converse contract (in act at esse only if existing at w0) and the degree-sense bridge are not recorded. The intensity is world-indexed and ranges over accessible worlds, while the Fourth Way degree is world-free and ranges over bearers of esse. Choosing value := intensity w0 as a bare parameter would hide that identification.
